# Phase One — Limitless Relationship Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos is beyond follower and followed, yet Awtsmoos.com may reveal every social edge as a truthful beam: quick to inspect, safe to change, clear to the eye, and never duplicated into five drifting client stories.

## Every possibility

- One canonical relationship-status read for any acting alias and typed target.
- Existing follow/unfollow writes remain the only mutation authority.
- Profile buttons never scan five pages merely to learn one boolean.
- Network collections stay authoritative list views rather than client caches.
- People remains public discovery unless a future batch relationship contract is proven.
- Future relationship truth may include mutuality, notifications, timestamps, and recommendation relevance only when backend evidence exists.
- Mutation state remains explicit and duplicate clicks remain blocked.
- Identity/profile target changes reject stale relationship responses.
- Logged-out and self-profile paths avoid needless requests.

## Competing architectures

A. Global relationship cache — rejected: too much invalidation for one current point-read consumer.
B. Infer from Network list — rejected: bounded pages and route-dependent loading.
C. Social Kernel relation — rejected today: `follows` exists semantically but has `storageKind: null`.
D. New relationship storage — rejected: existing follow storage is canonical and bounded.
E. Point-read beside `/follows/:alias` — chosen: one request, no migration, no invented truth.
